content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of MANIT Bhopal to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MANIT Bhopal Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the MANIT Bhopal Assistant Professor recruitment is 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 31 vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor positions at MANIT Bhopal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline, with a first-class degree in preceding academic stages.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any relaxation in age for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates should refer to the official notification for specific information.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General category candidates is Rs. 1500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for Assistant Professors at MANIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per Level-10 or Level-12, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny of applications, a presentation, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online through the official MANIT Bhopal website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of MANIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: The official website of Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal is www.manit.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is Rectt/FR/2026/01.
